params.name: tradeId
params.description: Unique identifier for the executed trade.

items.docs: Provides trade information for a specific trade based on provided trade ID

info.name: Gets all Open Trades for a given district user ID, based on maturity date.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting point of the records to retrieve (pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to retrieve per page (pagination).

items.docs:
Retrieves all Open Trades for a provided district user ID, optionally filtered by counterparts. Results are based on maturity/settlement date.
Pagination is supported with 'offset' defining the starting point and 'limit' specifying the number of records per page.
The response includes links for previous and next pages.

info.name: Retrieves historical trades for a given district user ID within a date range, based on trade execution date.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting point of the records to retrieve (pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to retrieve per page (pagination).

items.docs:
Retrieves Historical Trades for a provided district user ID within a given date range, optionally filtered by counterparts. Results are based on trade execution date.
Pagination is supported with 'offset' defining the starting point and 'limit' specifying the number of records per page.
The response includes links for previous and next pages.
